name: Grobull the Transmuted
notes: The fight with Grobull could originally be skipped, but the door to Rkugamz will now remain sealed if your group doesn't defeat it.

summary: Grobull the Transmuted is a netch that serves as the second boss in Darkshade Caverns II. Although at first it appears to be wounded, Grobull will rise up and attack once you approach.
